description: This Java class 'JsonExamplesProducer' generates and writes a variety of JSON example files for testing and documentation purposes within a Ditto-related project. It includes sample data for things, attributes, features, ACLs, and associated exceptions, covering command requests, responses, and errors related to 'things' management.

classes.name: JsonExamplesProducer
classes.description: A utility class for generating JSON files that exemplify different 'things' operations and exception scenarios in the Ditto framework for testing and documentation.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that initiates the JSON file generation process based on a target directory provided as an argument.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Validates arguments and invokes produce to generate JSON files in the specified path.

methods.name: produce
methods.description: Coordinates the generation of command, response, and exception JSON files in subfolders.

methods.name: produceThingCommands
methods.description: Generates all 'thing' command request JSON files.

methods.name: produceThingQueryCommands
methods.description: Creates JSON files for various 'thing' query command requests.

methods.name: produceThingQueryResponses
methods.description: Creates JSON files for responses to 'thing' query commands.

methods.name: produceThingModifyCommands
methods.description: Creates JSON files for various 'thing' modify command requests.

methods.name: produceThingModifyResponses
methods.description: Creates JSON files for responses to 'thing' modify commands.

methods.name: produceThingExceptions
methods.description: Creates JSON files for various exception cases encountered during 'thing' operations.

methods.name: writeJson
methods.description: Serializes a Jsonifiable object and writes it to a specified file path, optionally with a schema version.
